title: drive-coding CLI specs override
description: Per-CLI overrides for bin/args/env/displayName/logo. Loaded by loadCliSpecsOverride (packages/provider/src/config/cli-config-file.ts). Keys are CLI kinds (built-in or new); values are partial CliSpec overrides merged on top of CLI_SPECS from @drive-coding/core.

$schema.description: Pointer to this JSON Schema (ignored by the runtime parser).

cliSpecOverride.description: Partial CliSpec — every field is optional; unset fields fall back to the built-in CLI_SPECS.

bin.description: Executable path or PATH-resolvable name. Absolute paths are recognized without a symlink (v0.28.0+).

args.description: Fixed arguments always passed to the CLI.

supportsModelFlag.description: Whether the CLI accepts `--model <id>` on the command line. opencode/omp = false (model override happens via ACP session/new).

unsetEnv.description: Environment variables to delete from the child process before spawn (e.g. OneCLI proxy/CA vars).

setEnv.description: Environment variables to set/override on the child process before spawn. On collision with unsetEnv, setEnv wins.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the FE CLI dropdown. Absent → the CLI kind identifier is used.

logo.description: Local file path or HTTPS URL to a logo image. Plain HTTP URLs are blocked by the browser (mixed-content). Absent → a deterministic monogram is shown.

sessionMeta.description: Full _meta object for ACP session/new|load (deep-merged with built-in default for this CLI). Passthrough — only injected as _meta, never as top-level cwd/mcpServers.

injectDriveCodingMcp.description: When false, omits the drive-coding MCP server from session/new|load. Omitted = inject (default).

sessionMetaAllowDefaultOverride.description: When true, suppresses warnings when sessionMeta override changes built-in default values. Omitted/false = warn on conflicts at load.

cliTransport.description: How the backend carries the ACP wire to this CLI's agent (slice cli-transport). Omitted → stdio (in-process/spawn, today's behavior).

mode.description: stdio = local in-process/spawn. unix = sidecar over a Unix-domain socket. http = reserved, NOT implemented yet (errors at connect time).

sidecar.description: Run the agent as a separate process/unit. Omitted defaults to false for stdio and true for unix/http.

socketPath.description: Explicit socket file path for unix. Put it in a directory bind-mounted into both the backend and agent containers. Takes precedence over socketDir.

socketDir.description: Alternative to socketPath: a directory; the socket is <dir>/<agentId>.sock.

attachOnly.description: Never launch — only attach to a socket another process already bound (the agent container owns the sidecar's lifecycle). Meaningful only with a sidecar transport.

httpUrl.description: Reserved for mode=http — the base URL of the remote wire.

cliFs.description: Where this CLI's files live, for /api/fs browse + serve (slice cli-transport). Omitted → local (the backend's own disk).

oneOf.description: Browse/serve over WebDAV (an external rclone serve). The backend is a client only.

url.description: Base URL, e.g. an SSH-tunneled http://127.0.0.1:17654.

pass.description: Inline password — dev only. Prefer passEnv.

passEnv.description: Name of the env var holding the password — the recommended, committable form.

root.description: Absolute path on the remote host that is the WebDAV document root.
